instrument_name: SC2848 Power of Attorney and Declaration of Representative (Rev. 2/17/23)
figure_or_rule_carried: Form SC2848 appoints attorneys-in-fact before SCDOR; tax matters line asks type of tax (Individual, Corporate, Withholding, Sales...) and form number (SC1040, WH1605, ST-3 etc.); taxpayer signs page 2 line 7, representatives sign Part II; cannot be used to cash refund checks; return signing only per SC Code 12-2-75. Withholding is a listed tax type.

instrument_name: SC Revenue Ruling #22-3 Employer Wage Withholding Requirements (Income Tax)
figure_or_rule_carried: Ruling (8 pages) read locally with keyword search: no supplemental/bonus flat rate and no rounding rule in it; cites S.C. Code 12-8-10, 12-8-510, 12-8-520 and SC Regulation 117-910.1 (regulation text not read). Covers nonresident wages earned outside SC (COVID relief to 2022-06-30).
verification_method: read locally PyMuPDF; keyword search bonus/supplemental/round/flat = 0 hits

instrument_name: SCDOR tax types index (full list of taxes administered)
figure_or_rule_carried: Complete SCDOR tax index lists Individual Income Tax, Withholding, Non-Resident Withholding Scenarios and seven LOCAL SALES taxes (capital projects, county green space, education capital improvement, school district, tourism, transportation, Catawba tribal) but NO local income, payroll or wage tax: absence proven for SCDOR-administered local wage taxes. No SDI/PFML listed (SCDOR is not the labour agency, so part 4 not proven).

12-8-520(B): employer may compute wages to the nearest dollar. 12-8-550: 2 percent withheld from each payment to a nonresident performing temporary personal services in SC. 12-8-540: rent/royalty payments to nonresident of 1,200 or more: withhold maximum individual rate. Chapter 8 text read has no supplemental-wage rate, no agent/POA section and no reciprocal-exemption section.

instrument_name: S.C. Code 41-31-310 no-deduction; 41-31-160 agent electronic reporting
figure_or_rule_carried: 41-31-310: contributions shall not be deducted from employee wages (employer-only). 41-31-160: an agent reporting wages on ten or more employees for subject employers must file electronically.

instrument_name: S.C. Code 41-10-30 full text (A)-(C)
figure_or_rule_carried: (C) employer shall furnish each employee an itemized statement of gross pay and deductions for each pay period; (A) written notice at hire of hours, wages, time/place of payment, deductions; (B) records of names, addresses, wages and deductions for three years. Section text contains no prevailing-wage provision.

instrument_name: Unemployment Insurance Minnesota - Tax rates 2026 (Wayback 2026-10-12)
authority: Minnesota Department of Employment and Economic Development
figure_or_rule_carried: 2026 taxable wage base 44,000 per employee; base tax rate 0.40 percent; experience rating maximum 8.90 percent; additional assessment 14.00 percent; special (federal loan interest) assessment 0.00 percent; new employers (two years or less of wages): rate assigned by industry average. Page states: You cannot withhold UI tax from the wages you pay to employees. Agent information links exist (Who is an Agent).

instrument_name: UIMN Information Handbook - Taxable wage (Wayback 2026-05-18)
authority: Minnesota Department of Employment and Economic Development
figure_or_rule_carried: Taxable wage base is set each year at 60 percent of Minnesota average annual wage on June 30 of the previous year; UI tax paid on gross wages per employee up to the base (2026 figure 44,000 in US-MN-P5-2-001).

instrument_name: Minnesota Paid Leave - Premium rate and contributions (Wayback 2026-07-31)
article_or_section: Premium rate; small employer rate; OASDI cap
figure_or_rule_carried: For 2026 and 2027 premium rate 0.88 percent (Family Leave 0.27, Medical Leave 0.61) on wages up to the OASDI limit, stated on the page as 185,000; employers may collect up to 0.44 percent from employees; employers must contribute 50 percent (33 percent small employers); small-employer rate 0.66 percent (30 or fewer workers, average wage up to 150 percent of statewide average). Resolves earlier 0.7 vs 0.88 conflict: 0.88 is the official figure.
verification_method: read locally (Wayback 20260731171530; live page behind human-verification wall)

instrument_name: Minnesota Paid Leave Program Overview for Employers (7/28/2025)
figure_or_rule_carried: Premium rate 0.88 percent on wages up to the Social Security cap (this 2025 deck says 176,000, stale: use 185,000 from US-MN-P5-2-003 for 2026); first premiums due 2026-04-30; from 2026-01-01 employers can deduct up to 50 percent of premiums from paychecks; employee share 0.44 percent of wages in 2026; small employers pay half of the standard contribution.

instrument_name: Form REV184b Business Power of Attorney (MN Revenue)
figure_or_rule_carried: Business POA: limited authority by type of tax (e.g. Business Income, Sales, Withholding), form and periods, or full authority; optional powers include email contact and signing returns; REV184i for individuals and sole proprietors.

instrument_name: Arizona Form 821-PSC Withholding Tax Payroll Service Company Authorization (instructions 2024; form year 2025 published 2026-01-01)
figure_or_rule_carried: Taxpayer authorizes any individual or firm to sign and file withholding returns, make payments, inspect and receive confidential withholding information from the period on the form until four years after receipt or revocation; submit by POA@azdor.gov, fax (602) 716-6088 or mail ATTN Power of Attorney PO Box 29086 Phoenix AZ 85038-9086; other tax types or acts need Form 285.
verification_method: read locally PyMuPDF (Wayback 20250715075623 instructions; page copy 2026)

instrument_name: DES UIT-1146A Limited Power of Attorney (Unemployment Insurance)
figure_or_rule_carried: Employers authorize a third party to represent them before DES in specified UI matters; also permits DES to give the representative confidential Arizona UI account information; checkbox per matter or specific matter. Wayback copy 2025-10-30 is header FORFF (4-18).

instrument_name: A.R.S. 34-321 (public works wage rates)
figure_or_rule_carried: Agencies and political subdivisions shall not require public works contracts to contain a provision that wages paid be not less than the prevailing rate: Arizona has no prevailing-wage mandate for public works.

instrument_name: DES UI Tax FAQ (Wayback 2026-03-04) taxable wage base
figure_or_rule_carried: Taxable wage base 8,000 (7,000 before 2023-01-01) per worker confirmed. Question list includes Is unemployment tax withheld from an employee paycheck? but the answer is collapsed and not in the saved text: employee contribution answer NOT read.

instrument_name: ADOR Employer Withholding Filing Obligations (Wayback 2026-10-09)
figure_or_rule_carried: Every employer compensating an employee for services in Arizona must deduct and retain the prescribed amount; register EIN via Joint Tax Application JT-1, which also starts DES UI registration. Page has no local tax or rounding rule.

instrument_name: Wis. Stat. 103.457 Listing deductions from wages; Wis. Admin. Code DWD 272.10
figure_or_rule_carried: 103.457: employer shall state clearly on the paycheck, pay envelope or accompanying paper the amount of and reason for each deduction (coding system allowed; personal miscellaneous deductions excepted). DWD 272.10 adds the number of hours worked and the rate of pay. DWD wages page: direct deposit still requires a stub; electronic stub allowed if employee can print free.

instrument_name: Wis. Stat. chapter 103 contents and text (published 10-1-26)
figure_or_rule_carried: Chapter 103 as published 2026-10-01 has no sections 103.48 or 103.49 and no occurrence of the words prevailing wage; the only reference to s. 66.0903 is its 2013 stats version. Absence indicates no current state or local prevailing-wage statute in ch. 103 (repeal act itself not read).

instrument_name: Wisconsin DOR Publication 511 Office Audit (12/22) - Form A-222
figure_or_rule_carried: To let another person discuss and receive confidential tax information complete Form A-222 Power of Attorney; an alternate POA must be notarized and clearly authorise receiving tax information. Withholding coverage of A-222 comes from a search-result description, form itself not read. UI POA is UCT-8291-E (US-WI-P5-1-002).

instrument_name: Guide to Wisconsin Wage Statements and Information Returns Pub 117 (01/26) (Wayback)
figure_or_rule_carried: Saved and keyword-searched: W-2 and information-return guide; no local wage tax and no POA text found. Supports (does not prove) absence of local wage tax; W-166 also has none.
